objective: Retry quirurgico del Gate 5D hardening, exclusivamente porque R1 fue bloqueado por avance concurrente de Edarsahub_Desarrollo antes de ejecutar SQL. Ejecutar la misma migracion versionada 20260917_001_sql_principals_least_privilege.sql por SQL_MIGRATION_DEVELOPMENT, con el mismo SHA-256 exacto, preflight READ_ONLY y post-audit READ_ONLY. No SQL inline, no shell, no Production.

queries.name: preflight_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: preflight_hrlectura_roles
queries.sql: SELECT rp.name AS role_name FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals rp ON rp.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals mp ON mp.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id WHERE mp.name='HRLectura' ORDER BY rp.name

queries.name: preflight_hub_escritura_roles
queries.sql: SELECT rp.name AS role_name FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals rp ON rp.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals mp ON mp.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id WHERE mp.name='HUB_Escritura' ORDER BY rp.name

queries.name: preflight_required_objects
queries.sql: SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Roles'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos')) ORDER BY name

queries.name: post_hrlectura_roles
queries.sql: SELECT rp.name AS role_name FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals rp ON rp.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals mp ON mp.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id WHERE mp.name='HRLectura' ORDER BY rp.name

queries.name: post_hrlectura_effective_write_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(DB_NAME(),'DATABASE','CREATE TABLE') AS can_create_table,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo','SCHEMA','ALTER') AS can_alter_dbo,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos','OBJECT','INSERT') AS can_insert_rbac,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos','OBJECT','UPDATE') AS can_update_rbac,HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos','OBJECT','INSERT') AS can_insert_role_links

queries.name: post_hub_escritura_roles
queries.sql: SELECT rp.name AS role_name FROM sys.database_role_members drm JOIN sys.database_principals rp ON rp.principal_id=drm.role_principal_id JOIN sys.database_principals mp ON mp.principal_id=drm.member_principal_id WHERE mp.name='HUB_Escritura' ORDER BY rp.name

queries.name: post_hub_escritura_explicit_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT pe.state_desc,pe.permission_name,pe.class_desc,CASE WHEN pe.class=3 THEN SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) WHEN pe.class=1 THEN OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(pe.major_id) END AS schema_name,CASE WHEN pe.class=1 THEN OBJECT_NAME(pe.major_id) END AS object_name FROM sys.database_permissions pe JOIN sys.database_principals pr ON pr.principal_id=pe.grantee_principal_id WHERE pr.name='HUB_Escritura' ORDER BY pe.class_desc,schema_name,object_name,pe.permission_name
